blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Makati-based fine-dining restaurant FLOW received a Michelin Star on October 29, joining the growing list of Michelin-starred restaurants in the Philippines. The Filipino-Peruvian establishment brings the country’s total to nine one-star restaurants, with Helm remaining the only two-star restaurant. This raises the question: What separates a one-star restaurant from a two-star establishment? Furthermore, what distinguishes Michelin-starred restaurants from those awarded Bib Gourmand or classified as Michelin Selected?
